title: OTOKEN System - Yield Bearing Token System for Cardano DeFi

ms.promise: The system design specification is a detailed overview of the OToken Framework foundational components powering the protocol. It explains the system's architecture, its key functionalities and primary features. This output document produced will serve as the blueprint for developing the smart contracts and off-chain infrastructure necessary to operate the system.
ms.criteria:
The system design specification will consist of a technical document crafted by both the Optim Labs developers and financial engineers that presents an outline of the system for a technical audience to familiarize themselves with the overarching system logic. This document will: 
・Give an overview of the system by listing it's primary functionalities and features
・Describe each component of the system in detail outlining individual functionality
・Describe how each component of the system interacts with other components 
・Describe how the system's smart contracts integrate with other protocols

ms.promise: This informational Gitbook repository will abstract away the technicalities of the underlying OToken Framework in order to provide resources for learning and understanding the optimal assets and strategies to leverage the system. It will provide financial engineering guidelines and outline considerations necessary to create successful yield bearing tokens for the ecosystem, including suggested use cases and best practices for managing reserve assets.
ms.criteria:
The OToken Guidelines and Documentation will be hosted, organized and easily accessible on the existing Optim GitBook repository. It will provide information on the following:
・Understanding the optimal asset types for this system and their qualities
・Outline general considerations necessary to create successful yield bearing tokens 
・ Describe use cases and strategies through which people can leverage the OToken system
・List best practices for the ongoing management of reserve assets after asset creation

ms.promise:
The technical specification from the first milestone will be implemented using Aiken and/or PlutusV3, the leading Cardano smart contract programming languages in the ecosystem, to develop the core sets of smart contracts for the OToken Framework. The number of smart contracts will be determined by the scope of the system as it is implemented, and it’s based on the developers preferred method of organizing their codebase. The entire logic of the system could be implemented into just one smart contract, but it could also be better organized by splitting into smaller components. Our developers will use leading software engineering best practices when deciding the optimal number of smart contracts to best encapsulate the entirety of the system.
This open sourced codebase will be deployed on a private testnet or on a the mainnet with limited assets for internal verification and thorough testing of system logic, core mechanisms and key components. In order to ensure the safety, security and robustness of the OToken system, Optim Labs will launch a bug bounty program to incentivize community developers and security researchers to verify the codebase and smart contracts before a live deployment is launched. There will be a $20k USD worth of ADA (at current market price at time of announcement) prize pool for bugs that are properly identified and reported to the Optim lead developer. Outputs will include:
・Bug Bounty Program announcement and participation guidelines.
・Announcement of Bug Bounty Program conclusion and publishing a report detailing
